aboutpara: Founder and CEO of Ayu Health, an EHR-agnostic AI clinical intelligence layer for Indian doctors: vernacular voice capture and handwriting OCR turn a consultation into a structured medical record without the doctor typing or switching software. Ayu started with my mother's diabetes records, a bag of loose papers no specialist could read. Also VP of AI at Fusion Cyber, where I built Beacon AI, Rangsphera (AI cyber range) and Alice AI agents with VetCOMM (F3), Cisco, FIU, USC, Kentucky, Denmark & Lincoln university, scaling to $3M+ in revenue. Before that, ~2 years of ML research at IIT Bombay on OCR for Indian-language manuscripts. Smart India Hackathon 2022 winner; IITM Pravartak incubated; IIM Bangalore NSRCEL Healthcare & AI cohort; Google AI for Impact APAC Special Mention.
